description: SYNC SNDFILE ENDTIMES: builds (or re-times) a mixfile in which every sound ENDS at the same instant - start times = (longest duration - own duration), earliest at 0 (verified: 1 s / 2 s / 1.5 s files -> starts 1.0 / 0.0 / 0.5, all ending at 2.0). Same aux contract as submode 1, independently re-verified in this submode: the intextfile is either a bare sndfile list (output lines get level 1.0, pan 'C') or an existing mixfile (levels/pans preserved, lines re-sorted); durations are read from the soundfile headers on disk; sub-paths pass through; the output renders directly through submix mix. Deterministic (byte-identical run to run).
musical_use: Common-release alignment: hits, chokes and cadence chords land 'together' when they STOP together - sync 2 computes the offsets for arbitrary-length material in one call. Build convergence gestures (several swells of different lengths all resolving at one downbeat), align reversed material so the forward-attack moment coincides (reversed sounds end AT the attack), or gate a stack to a shared cutoff. The rendered mix's duration equals the LONGEST file exactly, and everything piles up at the end - run getlevel 3 before rendering (the shared endpoint sums hot; overload at the mix stage WRAPS). Output is a normal mixfile: re-level with attenuate, re-position with pan/spacewarp, render with submix mix.

intextfile.description: EITHER a plain list of soundfile names (one per line, cwd-relative; write with write_data_file()) OR an existing mixfile whose levels/pans should survive the re-timing. Renders in the argv BEFORE the output path. Missing names refuse 'Application doesn't work with this type of infile.'. Sample rates are NOT validated here (mismatch surfaces downstream at submix mix - verified in the sibling and shared by the mode's parser).

examples.description: Three gestures of different lengths resolving on one downbeat.
examples.expected_use: write_data_file('cadence.txt', 'inputs/g1.wav\ninputs/g2.wav\ninputs/g3.wav'). All end at t = longest duration; pre-flight with getlevel 3, then render via submix mix.

known_issues: Bare-list outputs carry pan 'C' = NO-PAN in submix mix (renders mono for all-mono lists); use numeric pans downstream if you need true placement, and convert before submix pan (its no-pan path is broken).
NO SAMPLE-RATE VALIDATION at this stage - mixed-rate lists pass (exit 0) and refuse only at render time.
Endpoint alignment stacks every file's final energy at one instant - pre-flight with submix getlevel 3 (mix-stage overload WRAPS).
The output is a DATA file (mixfile, .txt) - consumer = submix mix's mixfile parameter. Duration pre-flight skipped ('static' placeholder); rendered duration = the longest listed file, exactly.
Deterministic; no numeric parameters. Arity-0 entry: call process() with no input argument; duration_row null in the findings (data output).
